decisions.reason: As a newly launched 2018 resin injection unit with its own webpage, it reflects visible investment in a core application-technology segment, and after only one year management would attribute any weak uptake to normal market ramp-up rather than failure.

This second 2018 resin injection unit sits close to the firm's established fluid-handling and processing business, so given the recent launch and public commitment, management would persist rather than withdraw early.

The automatic airless spray gun is strongly aligned with the firm's core coating equipment offering, and escalation of commitment makes management reluctant to abandon such a recent, openly presented product before it has had time to gain traction.
The manual airless spray gun fits the firm's long-standing spray application portfolio, and with fresh launch-related investment already made, management would continue backing it in 2019.

The air-assisted airless spray gun supports the stated strategy of innovative and customized application solutions, so the firm would likely maintain it and treat any early commercial uncertainty as temporary.

Although the data logger is somewhat more adjacent than the spray guns, it still signals innovation in equipment support and process control, and the firm's recent visible commitment would favor keeping it on the market.
